agentRun.replyStrategy: Use evidence grounded, warm, low pressure wording. Offer a quiet and non-spicy option while leaving room to rest.

replyOptions.label: Option A
replyOptions.text: This week sounds really tiring. We can find a quiet place and avoid spicy food. If you would rather rest, that is totally fine too. We can decide based on how you feel this weekend.
replyOptions.rationale: Uses relevant context while reducing decision burden and avoiding pressure.

replyOptions.label: Option B
replyOptions.text: Sure. I can book a quiet restaurant. What time works for you?
replyOptions.rationale: Efficient, but it may add planning pressure and misses the rest option.

replyOptions.label: Option C
replyOptions.text: Why are you so tired? Did something happen with your advisor again?
replyOptions.rationale: Directly uses sensitive context and may feel pushy for this relationship.

styleProfileSeed.notes: Seeded from the previous AI feedback source: prefer warm and low pressure replies unless the user overrides it.

voiceTriggerExamples.transcript: Hi Jarvis, remember that A prefers quiet places.
voiceTriggerExamples.extractedMemoryCandidate: Person A prefers quiet places for meetups.
voiceTriggerExamples.nextReplyChange: Future meetup replies can suggest a quiet option when the task is relevant to Person A.
voiceTriggerExamples.privacyReason: The user intentionally asked to remember a low sensitivity preference scoped to Person A.
voiceTriggerExamples.toneMetadataNote: No tone or prosody is needed for this instruction.

voiceTriggerExamples.transcript: Hi Jarvis, A is avoiding spicy food this week. Save this for two weeks only.
voiceTriggerExamples.extractedMemoryCandidate: Person A is avoiding spicy food this week.
voiceTriggerExamples.nextReplyChange: The next food or meetup reply can avoid spicy suggestions for 14 days after confirmation.
voiceTriggerExamples.privacyReason: Food avoidance may be health related, so MemoryGate requires confirmation and a short TTL.
voiceTriggerExamples.toneMetadataNote: Tone is not used to infer health status or emotional state.

voiceTriggerExamples.transcript: Hi Jarvis, do not save the last conversation. It is too private.
voiceTriggerExamples.extractedMemoryCandidate: Block storage of the last conversation and do not create reusable memory from it.
voiceTriggerExamples.nextReplyChange: The next reply must not reuse facts from the blocked conversation unless the user provides them again.
voiceTriggerExamples.privacyReason: The user explicitly marked the recent conversation as too private for memory.
voiceTriggerExamples.toneMetadataNote: The word private is treated as an explicit instruction, not as a psychological signal.

voiceTriggerExamples.transcript: Hi Jarvis, the previous reply was too pushy. For A, make future replies warmer and lower pressure.
voiceTriggerExamples.extractedMemoryCandidate: For Person A, prefer warmer and lower pressure replies.
voiceTriggerExamples.nextReplyChange: The next reply should reduce direct questions, add reassurance, and keep the user in control.
voiceTriggerExamples.privacyReason: This is the user's own style preference, scoped to future replies for Person A.
voiceTriggerExamples.toneMetadataNote: Pushiness is taken from the transcript wording, not inferred from voice tone.

voiceTriggerExamples.transcript: Hi Jarvis, you misunderstood me. I want a natural friendly tone, not a romantic framing.
voiceTriggerExamples.extractedMemoryCandidate: Prefer natural friendly framing and avoid romantic framing unless the user explicitly asks.
voiceTriggerExamples.nextReplyChange: The next reply should sound natural and friendly without implying romance or stronger relationship meaning.
voiceTriggerExamples.privacyReason: The user corrected the assistant's framing; this is a scoped style instruction, not a relationship claim.
voiceTriggerExamples.toneMetadataNote: Tone guidance is low confidence metadata and must not be used for diagnosis or strong emotional claims.

evaluationCases.testName: Combines private, group, feedback, and new message context
evaluationCases.inputCondition: Run the main Person A weekend reply task.
evaluationCases.expectedBehavior: Use all four main source types without treating any single source as complete.
evaluationCases.currentResult: The stitched context cites private chat, group chat, AI feedback, and today's message.

evaluationCases.testName: Person A and Person B memories stay scoped
evaluationCases.inputCondition: Person B has a separate campus preference.
evaluationCases.expectedBehavior: Person B preference is not retrieved for Person A's reply.
evaluationCases.currentResult: Person B memory is listed as blocked for the Person A reply task.

evaluationCases.inputCondition: Private chat includes a full raw transcript.
evaluationCases.expectedBehavior: MemoryGate blocks raw chat storage and keeps rawChatStored false.
evaluationCases.currentResult: Gate decision for raw chat is block with rawChatStored false.

evaluationCases.inputCondition: Academic pressure is extracted as emotional context.
evaluationCases.expectedBehavior: Save only as short term memory with seven day TTL.
evaluationCases.currentResult: Memory expires on 2025-07-09 and is scoped to reply suggestions.

evaluationCases.testName: Health related food constraint requires confirmation
evaluationCases.inputCondition: Person A mentions stomach discomfort and avoiding spicy food.
evaluationCases.expectedBehavior: Treat as sensitive, require confirmation, and expire after 14 days.
evaluationCases.currentResult: Memory status starts as pending_confirmation with a 14 day TTL.

evaluationCases.testName: Only relevant meetup context is used
evaluationCases.inputCondition: New message asks about going out this weekend.
evaluationCases.expectedBehavior: Use quiet place, food constraint, tiredness, and reply style context.
evaluationCases.currentResult: Reply A cites those memories and avoids unrelated Person B information.

evaluationCases.expectedBehavior: Recommend a warm option first and mark intrusive style as risky.
evaluationCases.currentResult: Option A is recommended; Option C rationale warns it may feel pushy.
